text_block_list.text:
While out on an excursion, Satono Diamond 
paused in front of a giant poster.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
"The scariest roller coaster in amusement 
park history, 'Heaven', is born... 
Challengers wanted"?

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
Is it super tall... or super fast? What 
kind of coaster could it be...!

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: We simply must go to the amusement park!

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: Come on, Trainer-san. Let's get goingâª

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
Ah, look! Those tall rails... Isn't that 
the rumored scariest roller coaster!?

So that's “Heaven”... An altitude that 
pierces the very skies, on a scale truly 
worthy of its name!

text_block_list.name: Passerby A
text_block_list.text:
"Holy crap... it was seriously 
'Heaven'...! I never imagined something 
like that would happen..."

text_block_list.name: Passerby B
text_block_list.text:
No way, seriously no way... I literally 
saw my ancestors from five generations 
ago...!

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
Oh my, the riders look utterly 
exhausted...! Could this be—

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
My heart is starting to race! Feels like 
we're in for a whole new experience♪

"A part of me wants to try riding it, 
while another part is still scared. These 
two feelings take turns showing their 
faces..."

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
"Trainer, what's wrong? Are you not really 
feeling up to it...?"

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
In that case... I'll wait until you feel 
like it♪

We decided to take it easy around the park 
for a while, spending a genuinely peaceful 
time together.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: *Nom nom...*

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: Thank you for the meal♪

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
Ah, a roller coaster. Looks like the 
line's pretty short right now, isn't it?
choice_data_list:
You know you can ride it all by yourself, 
right?

You know you can ride it all by yourself, 
right?

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
Hmm... I think I'll pass on that! I'm sure 
it'd be fun alone, but still...

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
Because I probably won't be satisfied with 
just one person's worth of excitement.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
"...Come to think of it, Trainer, we went 
out together a lot, didn't we?"

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
"Peeking into unknown worlds together, 
making new discoveries—"

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
Challenging myself to brand new 
experiences, or searching for even more 
fun things to do...

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
"Just thinking back for a moment brings up 
so many wonderful memories. ...And that 
made me realize something."

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
That having you by my side, Trainer... 
makes all these heart-pounding moments so 
much more fun!

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
That's why I'll always be waiting for you♪ 
Until the time we can share that 
excitement together!
choice_data_list: Wanna go look for another adventure?

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: Okaaay, understood♪

However, I couldn't make up my mind at 
all. Curfew is fast approaching...

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: Well then... shall we head back?!

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
Yes. Actually, I am the type who saves my 
favorite food for last.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
So let's experience that thrilling 
excitement together someday♪

When that day comes, let's do our best. 
Looking at her smile, I made that silent 
vow!

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
Waaah, I was waiting for you to say that! 
Let's ride, let's ride!

(Rattle, rattle, rattle, rattle... 
Rrrrroooaaaar!)

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: Kyaaaaaー!

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
That was amazing, Trainer-san! I thought I 
caught a glimpse of a beautiful flower 
field!

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
...What kind of view will I see if I take 
the lead!

"Having to queue up repeatedly until 
getting to ride in the front made for a 
fun yet groggy day!"

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
Oh, my, what a wonderful idea! To be 
honest, I was curious about the other 
attractions too♪

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
Teacups, haunted houses... Let's play 
until our time runs out!

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
Come on, Trainer-san! First up is the 
haunted house~.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: Umm, the scariest haunted house... "Hell"!

"Even without riding a roller coaster, I 
was able to have fun with Satono Diamond!"
